Our Dual Diagnosis Program is designed for individuals navigating both mental health and substance use disorders. Through integrated, whole-person care that combines clinical therapy and psychiatric support, we help clients address the root causes of both conditions and build a path to lasting recovery.

Our Outpatient Rehab offers flexible addiction treatment in Gardena for individuals who don’t require 24/7 residential care. With options such as Intensive Outpatient (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization (PHP), this level of support is ideal for those transitioning from inpatient care or managing recovery alongside daily responsibilities.

Our residential program provides 24/7 immersive care for individuals with severe or persistent mental health needs. With an average stay of 30 days, clients receive intensive psychiatric support, a safe and supportive environment, and structured daily programming to promote stability and healing.

Our outpatient mental health program provides flexible therapy and psychiatric care for individuals managing conditions such as anxiety, depression, or OCD. This approach supports healing while allowing clients to maintain their daily routines.

Our Virtual IOP offers flexible, remote mental health care ideal for working adults, students, or those needing accessible support. Treatment typically includes virtual therapy for 3 hours a day, 3 days a week, over 8 to 12 weeks—providing structure and healing without disrupting daily life.

Our teen program provides age-appropriate care for adolescents facing emotional, behavioral, or mental health challenges. It focuses on balancing school life, family support, and integrated therapy to promote healthy growth and recovery.
Clear Behavioral Health has supported the well-being of patients throughout Southern California for over a decade.

We offer wellness amenities and inclusive services, including all-gender restrooms and culturally sensitive programming, to meet the diverse needs of our community. Here, every individual is welcomed and supported with personalized care in a healing environment.
Street parking is available on the south side of the street. We kindly ask to not park in the driveway.

mainEntity.name: How long is your residential addiction treatment in Gardena?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our residential rehab program in Gardena typically spans 30 days, although lengths may vary based on individual needs, ranging from 14 to 90 days depending on clinical evaluations.

mainEntity.name: Is your Gardena rehab facility covered by insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Clear Behavioral Health is in-network with most major commercial insurance plans, providing full cost transparency. While coverage depends on your specific policy, our admissions team is committed to helping you verify your benefits and ensure clarity before you begin treatment.

mainEntity.name: What should I bring to residential rehab in Gardena?

acceptedAnswer.text: We recommend contacting our admissions team directly—they can guide you on items like clothing, personal effects, and other essentials to bring for a comfortable stay.

mainEntity.name: Is Clear Behavioral Health’s Gardena rehab program co-ed or gender-specific?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Gardena facility offers care for both adult men and women within the same residential setting. While the program serves all genders, many therapeutic activities—such as group sessions—may occur separately.

mainEntity.name: What makes Clear Behavioral Health’s Gardena rehab unique?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Gardena residential rehab stands out thanks to a blend of clinical rigor and compassionate care: Holistic, evidence-based therapies including CBT, DBT, solution-focused therapy, mindfulness, experiential treatments (yoga, dance, sound therapy), and family involvement. Comfortable, home-like accommodations with modern amenities like semi-private rooms (shared), outdoor lounges, laundry access, and nutritious meals delivered to the center—designed to nurture both healing and community. A comprehensive continuum of care, featuring detox (integrated with MAT), residential rehab, and alumni support groups, plus outpatient and virtual follow-up to ensure lasting stability
